title: Three Small Words: a/an, the, to

vocabulary.meaning_en: the words a, an and the, used before nouns
a / an: one thing, general, not special
the: a specific or special thing that we both know
a sound like a, e, i, o, u at the start of a word
vocabulary.note_ar: المهم هو الصوت لا الحرف: an hour
vocabulary.note_en: It's the sound that matters, not the letter: an hour.
vocabulary.example: "Apple" starts with a vowel sound, so we say an apple.

vocabulary.meaning_en: exact; this one and no other
vocabulary.example: I mean a specific man: the man in the yellow jacket.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to + base verb (to go, to eat)
a word like to, in, at that shows direction, place or time
vocabulary.example: In "go to the store", to is a preposition.

vocabulary.meaning_en: word order; how words are arranged in a sentence
vocabulary.example: English syntax puts the subject before the verb.

vocabulary.meaning_en: difficult and not natural at first
vocabulary.example: It may feel awkward at first, but keep practising.

vocabulary.meaning_en: having the same idea or understanding
vocabulary.example: When I say "the car", we're on the same wavelength.
Your English will sound better instantly.

fine_lines.title: a vs an
fine_lines.explanation_ar: نستخدم an قبل الكلمة التي تبدأ بصوت حرف علّة (an apple, an hour)، و a قبل الصوت الساكن (a car, a university). المهم الصوت لا الحرف.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Use an before a vowel sound (an apple, an hour) and a before a consonant sound (a car, a university). The sound matters, not the letter.

examples.sentence: I'll be there in an hour.

fine_lines.title: a/an vs the
fine_lines.explanation_ar: a/an = واحد عام غير محدد (أي واحد). the = واحد محدد أو خاص نعرفه نحن الاثنين. Give me a marker = أي قلم. Give me the marker = القلم الذي نعرفه.
fine_lines.explanation_en: A/an = one, general, not special (any one). The = a specific or special one that we both know. Give me a marker = any marker. Give me the marker = the one we both know.

examples.sentence: Tell a woman I said hello. (any woman)
Tell the man in the yellow jacket I said hello. (that man)

expressions.phrase: I need to go to work.
expressions.example: It's late. I need to go to work.
Let's go out. It's a nice day.
My mother is the most important person in my life.
I'm going to visit my uncle this summer.

grammar.title: Articles: a/an and the
grammar.explanation_ar: الأدوات نوع خاص من الصفات: تخبرنا أن الاسم واحد (أو مجموعة واحدة)، وهل هو عام (a/an) أو محدد (the). تقريبًا معظم الجمل فيها أداة، فاستخدمها قبل الاسم المفرد المعدود.
grammar.explanation_en: Articles are a special kind of adjective: they tell us the noun is one (or one group), and whether it's general (a/an) or specific (the). Most sentences have one, so use one before a singular countable noun.
examples: I bought an apple. (not: I bought apple)
The machine broke down on Wednesday.
I had a pizza last night. The pizza was very good.

grammar.title: To: direction, infinitive, future
grammar.explanation_ar: (1) اتجاه: go to the store. (2) بين فعلين: فعل + to + المصدر (I want to go, I need to eat). (3) المستقبل: be going to + المصدر. لا تضع to بعد الأفعال الناقصة: must go وليس must to go.
grammar.explanation_en: (1) Direction: go to the store. (2) Between two verbs: verb + to + base verb (I want to go, I need to eat). (3) Future: be going to + base verb. Never put to after modals: must go, not must to go.
examples: Can we go to the zoo tomorrow?
I'm going to travel next month.
You must study. (not: must to study)

grammar.title: Practice technique
grammar.explanation_ar: اختر من فيديو تحبه جملتين أو ثلاثًا فيها a/the/to، وكرّرها بصوت عالٍ حتى تصبح طبيعية، ثم أضف جملًا جديدة.
grammar.explanation_en: From a video you like, choose two or three sentences with a/the/to and repeat them aloud until they feel natural; then add new ones.
examples: They brought an elephant from Africa.
Go to my house and get the keys.

questions.question: ___ man who called you is my brother.
questions.explanation_en: A specific man we both know: the.

questions.question: It's ___ good day when I get free money.
She is ___ most important person in my life.
Can we go ___ the zoo tomorrow?
I'll be back in ___ hour.
questions.explanation_en: Hour starts with a vowel sound: an.

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.
choices: I need to go to work tonight.
I need to go work tonight.
I need go to work tonight.
questions.explanation_ar: الإجابة الصحيحة: need to + go to work.
